question: Which state’s Chief Minister announced cashless medical treatment for all state teachers on Teachers' Day in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath announced cashless medical treatment for all state teachers, including primary, upper-primary, secondary teachers, Shiksha Mitras, instructors, and cooks.**
 
• **This initiative will cover approximately nine lakh teachers and their families.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **CM Yogi described this as a symbol of gratitude towards teachers for their contributions.**
 
• **Teachers and their families will no longer face financial difficulties due to illness or emergencies.**
 
• **On Teachers’ Day, CM Yogi also honoured teachers, distributed tablets, and inaugurated smart classrooms.**
 
• **CM emphasized that teachers must continue to perform their best for the education of children, with full government support.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About the Cashless Medical Treatment Initiative**__

 __
 
• Facility includes teachers in primary, secondary, and aided schools, along with Shiksha Mitras, instructors, and cooks.
 
• Designed to ease financial burdens on teachers and their families during health emergencies.
 
 
 
• **Teachers’ Day Event in Lucknow**__
 __
 
• CM Yogi honoured teachers and distributed tablets to enhance digital learning.
 
• Smart classrooms were inaugurated to further support modern education.
 
 
 
• **Government Support for Teachers**__
 
 
• CM assured continued full government support for teachers’ professional growth and well-being.
